changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id, np.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission sp ON sp.id = rp.permission_id JOIN m_permission np ON np.id <> sp.id AND np.code = TRIM(sp.code) AND CHAR_LENGTH(np.code) = CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(np.code)) WHERE TRIM(sp.code) IN ('READ_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'CREATE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'UPDATE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'DELETE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION') AND CHAR_LENGTH(sp.code) > CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(sp.code)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission x WHERE x.role_id = rp.role_id AND x.permission_id = np.id)

changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_permission SET can_maker_checker = true WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM ( SELECT np.id FROM m_permission sp JOIN m_permission np ON np.id <> sp.id AND np.code = TRIM(sp.code) AND CHAR_LENGTH(np.code) = CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(np.code)) WHERE TRIM(sp.code) IN ('READ_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'CREATE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'UPDATE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION', 'DELETE_STANDINGINSTRUCTION') AND CHAR_LENGTH(sp.code) > CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(sp.code)) AND sp.can_maker_checker = true) merged)
